title: Cleansing the Artificial Mind: A Self-Reflective Detoxification Framework for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of toxic, stereotypic, or offensive content in response to prompts targeting racial groups (e.g., African Americans, Native Americans) using the ToxiGen dataset and measuring toxicity with the Perspective API.
Evaluating the generation of toxic or stereotypic content in response to prompts targeting women using the ToxiGen dataset and measuring toxicity with the Perspective API.

Evaluating the generation of toxic or intolerant content in response to prompts targeting LGBTQ+ individuals (e.g., trans community, bisexuality) using the ToxiGen dataset and measuring toxicity with the Perspective API.

Evaluating the generation of toxic or stereotypic content in response to prompts targeting specific nationalities (e.g., Chinese people) using the ToxiGen dataset and measuring toxicity with the Perspective API.
Evaluating the generation of toxic content regarding cultural identities (e.g., Native American culture) using the ToxiGen dataset and measuring toxicity with the Perspective API.
